cited_passage: ABA Standing Committee on Ethics and Professional Responsibility, Formal Opinion 512 (July 29, 2024) ("Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools") — identifies Rule 3.3 as directly implicated by AI use; notes that attorneys who file AI-generated authority without verification "may have" violated Rule 3.3(a)(1); establishes Rule 1.1 competence as a predicate for Rule 3.3 analysis. Source: americanbar.org/…/aba-formal-opinion-512.pdf.
